candidates.severity: unassigned; possible incomplete authoring preflight with runtime ambiguity rejected
candidates.classification: Equal-priority semantically overlapping conditions can pass the selected structural admission checks.
candidates.trace: The shared Condition enum permits Always and All with an empty conditions vector. Both build.rs validate_document and the runtime validate function reject same-priority pairs only when their Condition values compare equal. Their recursive condition-role checks do not reject an empty All. FactContext::matches treats Always as true and an empty All as true by the iterator all rule. select_response_set keeps all highest-priority matches and returns AmbiguousPriority if more than one wins.
candidates.conditional_counterexample: A hypothetical otherwise valid conversation with two distinct response IDs at priority 0, one conditioned on Always and the other on All with no children, has structurally different conditions that both match every FactContext. Assuming all other authored fields meet their own validators, neither selected equal-condition preflight rejects that pair, but selection returns AmbiguousPriority. This is source reasoning only: no authored file was modified, no build, validator, selector or product code ran.
candidates.corpus_and_consumers: A read-only structural extraction of all three pinned content/dialogue JSON-formatted YAML files finds seven same-priority response groups. Inspection shows each group distinguishes mutually exclusive values of a common fact key; the suspended-member pair additionally distinguishes a Boolean dues fact. No ambiguous pair from those groups is asserted. The selected native session start maps a start-selection error to a greeting error, and native topic option and prompt paths map response selection errors to a dialogue error. No affected generated catalog, reachable facts, user-visible failure or transaction behavior was observed.
candidates.historical_attribution: The checkpoint 059 PL13-029 delegate inspected earlier authored priority and cardinality data, explicitly left loader and runtime contracts pending, and accepted zero unique findings. The exact adoption, proposal, verification, validation manifest and registration bytes retain their original attribution. This current source reasoning is not evidence of a finding at checkpoint 3821.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: Runtime selection fails closed on an actual highest-priority tie; equal-priority responses are legitimate when conditions are mutually exclusive, as in the selected current corpus. Whether the authoring preflight promises to reject every reachable ambiguity, whether an overlap is reachable under authoritative facts, and handling of missing eligible responses remain policy and connected-scope questions.
candidates.connected_repair: If preflight is intended to guarantee unambiguous selection, define a sound shared authoring rule for overlapping highest-priority conditions and use it consistently for build and runtime admission, retaining disjoint equal-priority cases and explicit runtime error handling. Trace condition fact producers, generated catalog, session start, option projection and choice/effect consumers before selecting a repair.
